 The incident is under investigation, the Marines said. 
 1:08 This is a breaking news story please check back for updates. ABC News By Anthony Trotter November 4, 2026, 4:37 AM Share TOKYO -- A U.S. Marine died following a training incident in Okinawa, Japan, on Tuesday, the Marines said, adding that the incident was under investigation.
 "It is with heavy hearts that 3rd Marine Division announces the death of a Marine following a training incident at Camp Schwab, Okinawa, Japan, on Nov. 3, 2026," the 3rd Marine Division said in a statement on Wednesday.
 Lt. Tyler Thomas, a spokesperson for the III Marine Expeditionary Force, declined in a brief phone interview to comment on whether the Marine died at the scene or was taken to a hospital. Thomas also declined to comment on whether others may have been injured in the incident, which he confirmed happened at Camp Schwab.
